name: treebird-oss-skills
description: Public Claude Code skills from the Treebird flock — cross-model workflows for driving and cross-checking other coding CLIs, audit skills that review any repo, plus review disciplines for hooks and onboarding flows

plugins.name: skill-codex
plugins.description: Delegate prompts to the OpenAI Codex CLI for code analysis, refactoring, code review, and automated editing

plugins.name: skill-clodex
plugins.description: Bounded Claude-to-Codex peer-review loop — two models argue a question to a verdict, and unresolved disagreements escalate to the human

plugins.name: skill-rls-audit
plugins.description: Audit a deployed Supabase project for multi-tenant RLS leaks — policy shape, tenant-claim provenance, the bypass surfaces RLS never covers, and a two-tenant black-box proof

plugins.name: skill-hooks-create
plugins.description: Hook-authoring protocol — grills you through the portability, blocking, and silent-failure patterns before a single line of hook code gets written

plugins.name: skill-ux-foolproof-review
plugins.description: Execute your own onboarding flow as a complete stranger — cold environment, zero credentials, zero tribal knowledge — and log every point of friction as a product bug

plugins.name: skill-opencode
plugins.description: Delegate builds, refactors, and analysis to the opencode CLI — scaffolding, session resume, and a critical pass over what it returns

plugins.name: skill-privacy-review
plugins.description: A fearless privacy inventory of any app holding sensitive user data — hunts the gap between the privacy the product promises and what the code actually enforces

plugins.name: skill-sql-review
plugins.description: Review SQL migrations and queries in any repo — migration safety, RLS correctness, function security, privilege drift, concurrency races, blanket grants, query quality

plugins.name: skill-ts-review
plugins.description: Security-scoped TypeScript/JS review — input validation, subprocess spawning, env leakage, path traversal, file permissions, error discipline, CSP transport coverage

plugins.name: skill-node-review
plugins.description: Review the JS/Node package & build layer — lockfile integrity (drift that installs but fails npm ci), package-manager hygiene, dependency-bump safety, runtime compatibility
